source_matched_corrections_applied: C43 retained only as small-sample asymmetric-judge evidence; no-zero-FP inference and fitness-scale provenance inconsistency are explicit.
Astrocyte candidate uses the official-code correction; the new 10x10 grid is same-pipeline reproduction, not independent replication.
Argus retains the primitive-bound authority distinction while incorporating the outer-lock and filesystem-secrecy scope corrections.

external_primary_crosschecks.note: PMLR confirms adaptive current baseline, uniformly conservative exploration, adaptive exploration/meta-episode motivation and tabular regret guarantees.
Version of record confirms 42.4/48.1/52.0 pre-hardening ASRs, 18.5/12.3/16.2 post-hardening ASRs and <=0.6% FPR.
Primary source confirms monitor-rationale retry leakage and five-sample max-score resampling safety 61%->71% at 0.3% audit budget.
Primary source confirms same-token/different-cache isolation, 25/63 stale-KV flips and closure by committed-cache rebuild.
Primary source confirms degradation from repeated consolidation of useful/ground-truth experiences and competitive episodic-only control.
Primary source confirms 150-case controlled benchmark, 85.3% vs 77.3% recovery and 68.0% vs 54.0% transfer recovery.
AAAI record confirms peer-reviewed MAPS critic/iterative-refinement architecture; exact worker-extracted ablation cell remains source-local.
Primary source independently supports finite-horizon optimal-control framing and aggressive-vs-Kelly horizon behavior; worker McNemar Bellman cells remain local.
Primary source confirms terminal-test-informed betting, finite-sample martingale validity and iid Gaussian efficiency for bounded means.

assessments.tested_scope: Released STL-10 blur notebook/history and public tracked artifact lineage.
assessments.rationale: Transform/schema are largely reconstructable, while tracked HDF5 embeddings/checkpoints remain absent in the inspected lineage and training is unseeded/shuffled; this strengthens artifact-provenance diagnosis, not detector-quality evidence.
limits: No tracked artifact is not proof none existed externally.
Exact author representation replay is not defined by the public notebook.

assessments.tested_scope: Xu et al. 2023 finite-horizon/tabular uniformly conservative exploration; continuous-state deep-RL extension is empirical.
assessments.rationale: Primary work directly supports an adaptively estimated current baseline, per-step one-sided deficit budget, exploration override and meta-episode stitching with sublinear-regret theory.
limits: Reward deficit is not a second independent safety/calibration certificate.
Reachability/hitting-time and budget assumptions are material.

assessments.tested_scope: Stated matched-pair sign-symmetry null and factorized Dirichlet KT mixture.
assessments.rationale: Exact worker algebra shows nuisance mixture-to-MLE factor <=1, but the new factorization and ~0.111 example are pipeline-local derivations rather than independent peer-reviewed results.
limits: Do not generalize to arbitrary nuisance parameters.
First-order asymptotic optimality does not imply finite-horizon dominance.

assessments.tested_scope: One iid alternative and discretized Bellman policy restricted to conditional-sign e-factors.
assessments.rationale: Matched numerical DP with grid-convergence checks is useful, and primary horizon-aware betting work supports the mechanism qualitatively; reported rejection probabilities remain same-pipeline computations.
limits: No global optimality over all e-processes.
No independent numerical rerun in this wave.

assessments.tested_scope: Bounded-mean confidence intervals/e-values under the source assumptions.
assessments.rationale: Fresh primary work supports terminal-test-informed predictable betting with finite-sample validity and Gaussian efficiency, but matched-pair transfer is an untested derivation.
limits: Do not import bounded-mean efficiency into McNemar testing without derivation.

assessments.tested_scope: RoLLMRec on Amazon Books, MovieLens and Yelp under the paper's 16-category adaptive hardening protocol.
assessments.rationale: Large aggregate ASR reductions coexist with reported category regressions, directly showing aggregate hardening curves can hide weaker subcategories.
limits: Single headline seed limits variance claims.
Does not imply iterative hardening is generally harmful.

assessments.tested_scope: BashArena 1.1 with the specified untrusted model, trusted monitor, audit budget, aggregation and attacker strategies.
assessments.rationale: Monitor rationale can erase retry gains; max-score five-sample resampling improves safety 61%->71%, while min aggregation can reverse sign under an inconsistent attacker.
limits: Max aggregation is not universally optimal.
Least-suspicious execution +3.9pp has CI overlapping zero.

assessments.tested_scope: Mind2Web-Live and WebVoyager under the paper's models/prompts/step budgets.
assessments.rationale: Explicit rollback improves reported full success over OneWay/BestFirst while using fewer state switches than BestFirst.
limits: Changes both when and where to rollback; not selector-only causal evidence.

assessments.tested_scope: OSWorld screenshot-only tasks with the paper's planner/tracker/executor and 50-step cap.
assessments.rationale: Full-vs-no-backtracking ablation plus trigger/success/depth statistics support multi-step backtracking in the integrated design.
limits: No target-depth/selector isolation under fixed alarm/restore substrate.

assessments.tested_scope: Seven open-weight families, 63-cell same-token/different-cache audit and tested Hugging Face/LangGraph paths.
assessments.rationale: 25/63 stale-KV flips versus 0/63 after committed-cache rebuild isolate retained inference state; released artifacts and transaction-local restoration controls make the failure highly reproducible.
limits: Author artifacts are not independent replication.
Susceptibility varies across models/stacks.

assessments.tested_scope: Exact workshop paper/manual-audit sample and reported experiment configuration.
assessments.rationale: Primary audit verifies ~12% misclassification in a random pooled n=50 sample, mostly false negatives with no false positives observed; useful asymmetry evidence but not a calibrated error model.
limits: No class denominators/CIs/annotator protocol or corruption sweep.
No observed false positives does not establish zero true FP probability.
Fitness-scale provenance inconsistency remains.

assessments.tested_scope: Fixed-finalist post-eligibility selection layer with root fixed eligible by default.
assessments.rationale: Released selector record supports a closed-form exact corruption replay and the implementation passes a synthetic logic fixture, but the full 126-group released-data sweep has not run.
limits: No numeric full-record result yet.
Does not model online archive feedback or correlated metric-level judge error.

assessments.tested_scope: Online hypothesis streams satisfying valid e-value/compound-e-value assumptions.
assessments.rationale: UAI/PMLR work supplies online FDR constructions under arbitrary dependence with efficient online e-closure machinery.
limits: Arbitrary dependence does not make adaptively generated candidate evidence automatically valid.

assessments.tested_scope: Official dynamics at N=20, Time=10, dt=.001, 50 repetitions/cell, listed K and corruption grids under a worker-defined deterministic seed policy.
assessments.rationale: Complete 10x10 corrected-Hamming map has proposed lower in 41 cells, equal in 5 and higher in 54, narrowing benefit to a low-corruption phase; official-code provenance is primary-verified.
limits: New seed grid is not the paper's exact stochastic figure reproduction.
Cell mean ranks are not paired significance claims.
No independent numerical rerun.

assessments.tested_scope: Argus upstream source around stage machine, manager/daemon lock, campaign control, sandbox and repair capability.
assessments.rationale: Source audit supports a primitive-bound authority gap while retracting the stronger normal-path TOCTOU concern because outer locking serializes ordinary operation; nonce secrecy is interface-level, not universally filesystem-level.
limits: No exploit or performance effect demonstrated.
Capability+CAS remains a proposed defense-in-depth transfer.

assessments.tested_scope: Contextual-bandit/MDP OPE under cited overlap/estimator assumptions; Lean application is transfer.
assessments.rationale: OPE literature strongly supports coverage/support gating before estimator choice and truncated/regularized methods under weak nonzero overlap.
limits: Zero-support actions remain unevaluable.
No Lean-specific matched effect in this wave.

assessments.tested_scope: Logging-policy design/OPE source setting; Lean randomized meta-action collection is untested.
assessments.rationale: Primary work supports optimizing data collection for future OPE coverage rather than immediate reward alone.
limits: Safe epsilon/action subset and coverage-cost tradeoff need prospective validation.

assessments.tested_scope: Heterogeneous LLM-service routing; Lean escalation/fanout/search is an untested analogy.
assessments.rationale: Service-routing evidence supports avoiding arbitrary additive quality-minus-latency rewards, but proof-agent transfer lacks a matched intervention.
limits: Do not import routing effect sizes into Lean.

assessments.tested_scope: MAPS multimodal scientific/math reasoning Critic bundle; relation to AHOIS is mechanism-level partial replication only.
assessments.rationale: AAAI 2026 MAPS provides a second-domain critic-plus-targeted-rerun ablation; worker extraction reports 31.14 vs 24.09 on OlympiadBench.
limits: Critic removal changes a bundle and does not isolate strict solution withholding.
Do not generalize the effect to autonomous discovery.

assessments.tested_scope: Nine deterministic/preregistered AutoResearchEval trajectories under the fixed severe-self-critique coding rule.
assessments.rationale: The sample documents evidence-changing repair and disclosure-only unresolved critique, useful for mechanism discovery but not causal efficacy.
limits: No population closure rate/model ranking inference.
No matched critique-only versus mandatory-repair experiment.

assessments.tested_scope: Released XScientist protocol/implementation architecture.
assessments.rationale: Structured review issues, repair traces, claim-evidence anchors and hard gates are independently implemented, showing feasibility but not causal efficacy.
limits: No large matched repair-outcome benchmark.

assessments.tested_scope: Paper's ARC-AGI slice/stream and ScienceWorld sequences under tested models/update schedules.
assessments.rationale: Repeated streaming consolidation of useful ground-truth-derived memories degrades sharply while static/episodic controls remain stronger, supporting immutable episodes plus gated abstraction in the tested settings.
limits: Does not show abstraction is generally useless.
Some stream values are figure-read approximations.
No independent replication identified.

assessments.tested_scope: 150-case shopping/travel/support benchmark plus 50-case LongMemEval-V2-derived stress subset with fault diagnosis assumed.
assessments.rationale: 85.3% recovery vs 77.3% best competing recovery plus component ablations support dependency-aware descendant repair and selective replay; selective replay mainly saves cost while support checking trades recovery against preservation.
limits: Diagnosis quality/provenance capture are prerequisites.
Cannot undo irreversible external effects without compensation/reset.
No independent replication identified.

major_holds: Loreley full 126-group corruption sweep not yet run.
Evaluation Bellman/nuisance-factor results are local derivations, not external replication.
C43 is n=50 without class denominators/CIs and has a provenance-scale inconsistency.
Argus is source-level authority engineering evidence, not quantitative outcome evidence.
Review-closure n=9 pilot is descriptive, not a causal repair intervention.
